people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.
translations.bsb: Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest shall belong to him.
translations.kjv: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest,
translations.asv: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.
